items.title: OpenJDK: improper handling of slash characters in URI-to-path conversion (8305312)

fix.t: For details on how to apply this update, which includes the changes described in this advisory, refer to: https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258 All running instances of IBM Java must be restarted for this update to take effect.
